records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Analytics
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Analytics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Positive signals: first_project reached day 0 and 1 invite sent, so the admin is exploring (facts; welcome email email:04b8a7c5). But no reply, no tickets, and no key_milestone in 6 days suggests drift; 8 days remain, so some chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

You're off to a good start in Wrenfield with your first project created and an invite out the door. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the first few tasks is usually the step that makes the rest click.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how you want your work organized and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Nadia
